title: Optimal Team Sizing Protocol
purpose: Provide a data-driven decision framework for selecting team sizes based on the empirically validated power law E = 4.0 * N^(-0.75), where every doubling of team size reduces per-agent output by 40-50%. This SOP translates 3,247 data points across 20 teams and 132 agents into actionable sizing rules.
scope: All multi-agent operations requiring team size selection. Applies to research, build, test, and mixed operations.

key_findings.power_law: E = 4.0 * N^(-0.75). Efficiency (artifacts per agent) decreases as a power law with team size.
key_findings.binding_constraint: The 89% efficiency loss at 16+ agents is cognitive (context-switching, communication ambiguity, work duplication), NOT infrastructure. Infrastructure overhead is <1% at ALL team sizes (0.35-0.74%).
key_findings.pattern_vs_size: Cooperation pattern selection causes 96x variance in efficiency (parallel-test at 12.0 vs 8-team-pipeline at 0.125). Team size causes only 17x variance. Pattern choice matters 5.6x more than team size.

step_1.question: What is the primary task type?

step_2a.rationale: Solo researchers achieve 5.5x mean efficiency. No inter-agent communication needed. Each agent explores independently.
step_2a.team_structure: N solo researchers + 1 coordinator (hub reporting only)
step_2a.escalation: If research topics are interdependent, use 2-3 agents with direct channels, but expect efficiency to drop to 1.0-1.5.

step_2b.question: How many independent modules or components?

1_module.rationale: 3 agents stays under the SQLite 4-writer contention cliff while providing enough parallelism for one module.

2_to_3_modules.recommendation: 2 teams of 3 agents each + 1 coordinator = 7 total
2_to_3_modules.rationale: Each team of 3 stays under the contention cliff. Work stealing between teams prevents idle time.
2_to_3_modules.connection: Hub for status + channels between teams for work stealing

4_plus_modules.warning: Beyond 8 total agents, historical efficiency craters. Use work stealing aggressively to keep agents productive.
4_plus_modules.hard_limit: Never exceed 15 total agents. Beyond 15, mean efficiency drops to 0.32.

step_2c.rationale: Testing parallelizes perfectly with partitioned suites. TEAM-0024 achieved 12.0 efficiency (highest ever observed) with this pattern.
step_2c.prerequisites: Test suites must be partitionable. Each tester gets a disjoint subset.
step_2c.connection: Hub for status + channels for progress broadcast + bottleneck detection

step_2d.sqlite_partitioning: 3 databases: research-hub, build-hub, test-hub. Max 4 concurrent writers per DB.

procedures.title: Classify the Task
procedures.action: Determine whether the work is primarily research, build, test, or mixed. Use the decision tree to select initial team size.
procedures.output: Task classification and initial team size recommendation

procedures.title: Apply Pattern Selection
procedures.action: Choose the cooperation pattern BEFORE finalizing team size. Pattern selection causes 5.6x more variance in efficiency than team size. Prefer parallel patterns (parallel-test: 12.0, solo: 5.5) over sequential patterns (wave-sequential: 0.176, pipeline: 0.125).

procedures.title: Check SQLite Constraints
procedures.action: Ensure no single SQLite database has more than 4 concurrent writers. For teams of 5+, partition into sub-groups or use a single-writer coordinator proxy. See SOP-034 for details.

procedures.title: Validate Against Warning Thresholds
procedures.action: Check the team size against warning thresholds. If any threshold is exceeded, require written justification before proceeding.

thresholds.yellow_warning: Team size > 8: Historical mean efficiency drops to 0.36. Requires justification for each agent beyond 8.
thresholds.orange_warning: Team size > 10: Per-agent overhead exceeds 45ms. Total coordination overhead exceeds 45ms.
thresholds.red_warning: Team size > 15: Mean efficiency 0.32. 89% efficiency loss vs solo. Do NOT proceed without unique-per-agent justification.
thresholds.hard_stop: Team size > 20: Only 7 teams have operated at this scale. All showed 0.125-0.471 efficiency. Not recommended under any circumstances.

procedures.output: Validated team size with justification if thresholds exceeded

procedures.title: Monitor and Adjust
procedures.action: During operation, track artifacts produced per agent. If efficiency drops below 0.5, consider splitting the team or reassigning idle agents via help protocol.
procedures.monitoring_frequency: Every phase transition or every 30 seconds via coordinator dashboard
adjustment_triggers: Any agent idle for >120 seconds: reassign via help protocol
Efficiency below 0.5 artifacts/agent: split team or reduce size
Work queue empty with agents still running: check for duplication

anti_patterns.name: The Army Approach
anti_patterns.description: Deploying 20+ agents expecting more agents = more output.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Power law E = 4.0 * N^(-0.75) means 20 agents produce only 6.4 total artifacts vs 5.5 from a single agent. The marginal agent at size 20 contributes 0.32 artifacts.
anti_patterns.fix: Use 5-8 agents with better pattern selection instead.

anti_patterns.name: The Pipeline Trap
anti_patterns.description: Serializing work across teams in a long pipeline (wave-sequential, 8-team-pipeline).
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Pipeline patterns show 0.125-0.176 efficiency. Agents waiting for upstream stages do zero useful work. Parallel patterns are 30x more efficient on average.
anti_patterns.fix: Maximize parallelism. Use pipelines ONLY for true stage dependencies, capped at 5-10 stages.

anti_patterns.name: Ignoring Pattern Selection
anti_patterns.description: Optimizing team size without selecting the right cooperation pattern first.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Pattern selection causes 96x variance vs team size causing 17x. Optimizing size alone captures <20% of available efficiency gains.
anti_patterns.fix: Always select cooperation pattern before finalizing team size.

references.data_points: 28 teams, efficiency by size and pattern

compliance_indicators: All teams sized within recommended ranges for their task type
No team exceeds 15 agents without documented justification
Pattern selection documented before team size finalization
SQLite writer count per database does not exceed 4
metrics.measurement_method: Track artifacts produced per agent per operation. Compare against power law prediction E = 4.0 * N^(-0.75). Flag if actual efficiency falls below 50% of prediction.
